title: Bat Detector Pass Activity
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=batdetector:pass
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as passes, dc(species) as species by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts bat passes and species from an ultrasonic detector through the evening, revealing your garden's after-dark aviators.
value: Bats are near-invisible but vital; a pass count by hour makes their emergence and foraging a tangible part of your wildlife record.
implementation: Ingest bat-detector passes into `index=personal`; review activity by hour and species through the night.
visualization: Time chart of bat passes with species diversity.
grandmaExplanation: It counts the bats flying past a special microphone each evening, revealing the creatures active after dark.
